newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-KPN says has 91.9 pct of TNT.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-KPN says has 91.9 pct of TNT.

text.p: Dutch postal and telecoms group Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (KPN) said on Tuesday it had recieved acceptances for 91.9 percent of the ordinary stock and 80.2 percent of the converting preference stock of TNT Ltd.
The company declared its A$2 billion bid for transport group TNT unconditional late last month after it received acceptances for more than 50 percent of the issued capital.
KPN previously said the bid would be unconditional from a level of 90 percent of acceptances. The A$2.45 cash offer for ordinary and preference shares closes on December 12.
